parent_boundary: Any later economic candidate must start from complete frozen f696 Stage1 allocation and b472 action/risk/recovery chain, first screen at 0bp added slippage with IBKR Tiered fees and its own full funded account against SOXX.

source_gate: Each exact URL must return HTTP200, CSV with date and 10-year real yield, finite values, unique dates, correct year range and no conflicting overlap. Retain exact bodies, headers, request/receipt UTC times and SHA-256. Stop at first failure and archive received bytes; do not substitute another endpoint.
timing_gate: The rates are derived from indicative closing bids. No same-date SOXX open use. A later candidate may inspect a value only after two Qlib sessions, and must separately prove historical first-public/revision identity; today's archived CSV alone is not PIT certification.
source_only_analysis: After source identity and NAS readback, use native Qlib D.calendar to count source dates and a two-session delayed availability map over the original Stage1 training and reused held calendars. Do not read SOXX outcomes, fit a model, run a native account, select sign/threshold/lookback, or claim independent forward days.
NAS_backup: Publish exact received CSV bytes, response-header receipts and source manifest as an immutable Yanxuan NAS snapshot; verify remote SHA-256, size and scoped restore before using the local CSV.
stop: If transport, identity, coverage, Qlib alignment or NAS check fails, record concrete dependency and stop. Source coverage is not a predictive information gate; no economic 0bp account until source/vintage and separately frozen information gates pass.
